crew_blueprint_task: Agent ↔ Roadmapdev orchestration with COMPLETE / NEEDS_EVIDENCE / BLOCKED
verified_behaviors: routine deterministic local work can remain DORMANT
consequential Crew Blueprint research-sufficiency questions enter the analytical path and request the research locator
explicit audits route as Roadmapdev audit work
cross-system consequential audits use the rich analytical profile
missing evidence returns bounded NEEDS_EVIDENCE requests
blocked authority returns BLOCKED and does not become action
Roadmapdev never manufactures write authority over Crew Blueprint

crew_blueprint_usage.when_to_call: Use for research sufficiency, curriculum prioritization, conflicting evidence, architecture/system-contract choices, historical reconciliation, major audits, or explicit owner requests to use Roadmapdev.
crew_blueprint_usage.complete: Roadmapdev has enough authorized evidence to provide the requested advisory analysis; the working Crew Blueprint agent still applies local governance and owner/publication gates.
crew_blueprint_usage.needs_evidence: Retrieve only the bounded missing evidence from the authoritative source if access is authorized, then rerun analysis. Do not fill gaps from model memory or historical branch recency.
crew_blueprint_usage.blocked: Stop the proposed analytical/action path and surface the authority, retrieval, unsupported-capability, or integrity blocker. Do not reinterpret BLOCKED as a recommendation to bypass the gate.

decision: Do not build a duplicate Crew Blueprint-specific orchestration engine. Bind Content Pipeline v2 to the existing Roadmapdev wrapper and preserve Roadmapdev as advisory.
